title: Spacetime Reverser
text: Any sapling can be rewound into a Time Sapling. Any music disc can be converted into one Liu Nian disc.
Ordinary Temporal Silt becomes Living Temporal Silt in five seconds for one energy, without changing quantity. Sedimented and rotted silt still rewind one stage and become activated.
Each operation takes five seconds and one time energy; capacity is 64. Time Energy Materials lists compatible fuel and its energy values.
Exchange memory cubes and lilies, rewind and activate silt, or uncover the past of fossils and eggs. Two Time Warp Points yield one Time Microcore; sixteen Spatial Crystals yield one Space Microcore.

Condense remains into royal essences, or inactive T-virus solution into psychic talent solution. Each grants a talent together with Time Distortion. An existing talent prevents consumption; the Cleansing Ritual removes both talent and curse.
